ctx.x: Composer David Baker talks about the neglect of this music; the carelessness evident in documenting this music and putting it on good terms with others of the world's great musics. This is so perhaps because ignorance and inaccurate historical attention. It is so perhaps because of the growth of the world and the many uses of the music which obscure its origins and continuity in its original culture. It is so.
We will be talking at length with Mr. Ware, considered by his contemporaries and followers as a primary American bass innovator.
